description: Synthetic Dataset for Power System Topology Optimization is a data set deposited in 4TU.ResearchData by its authors Ali Rajaei. The datasets consist of synthetic operating scenarios generated for PGLib-OPF benchmark power system networks. They are intended for research on machine learning methods for transmission system topology optimization and congestion management. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-NC-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-4tu-repository.
